Before you choose

  • Graduate degree and admission records

    MAOL applicants need a conferred bachelor’s degree from an accredited U.S. institution or an equivalent international institution and the required official records. Applicants below the published 3.0 GPA guideline must provide a personal statement. UMPI makes the individual admission decision.

    Current UMPI MAOL graduate admission requirements

  • Final-assessment proficiency

    YourPace requires at least 80 on the required final assessment. This is an assessment threshold; it does not establish a transfer grade, a graduation GPA or whether an assessment is monitored.

    Current UMPI YourPace final-assessment threshold

    Pace used in this example

    • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
    • 6–12 credits per university 8-week YourPace session is a planning assumption.
    • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
    • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
    • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

    What this range leaves out

    • External transcript or international credential-evaluation charges, when applicable.
    • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
    • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
    • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
    • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
    • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
    • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
    • Current MAOL page states no hidden fees or additional textbook costs. Tuition is $2,450 per eight-week session, not a guaranteed degree total.
    • The completion rate and paid-session count are student scenarios; UMPI controls the actual degree progress report and enrollment sequence. Calendar-month conversion is not assumed for an eight-week billing session.

    Published rates and sources

    • UMPI MAOL flat tuition per eight-week session; no application fee or hidden fees Reviewed 2026-11-25
